points.label: Sep 2026
points.source: Texas TxDMV vehicle registrations (271 vs. 191 prior)
points.disputeNote: This counts total TX robotaxi-program vehicle registrations, not necessarily active/unsupervised units. A separate tracker reported only 42 authorized and ~20 actively running driverless the same week — registered and operational fleet size are not the same number.

points.label: Sep 26, 2026
points.source: Tesla Oracle, citing TX vehicle registrations: 420 Model Y Robotaxi + 126 Cybercab
points.disputeNote: Teslarati separately described the fleet as having "doubled to well over 100 units" over the same Sep 26–28 weekend — likely referring to active/visible vehicles rather than total TX registrations. As with the Sep 2026 figure above, registered and actively-driverless counts are not the same number; this still points the same direction — fast growth — but the exact active count is unconfirmed.
